$comment: Plain-words consent notices (PRV-05, PRV-12). Every consent row records the version of the notice shown; draft notices wait for counsel's review under D13 before any pilot.

notices.text: Get help from the online tutor when this computer is slow. Your question and the steps so far are sent to our online service to answer it. They are never used to train a model.
Help a study find out whether the tutor helps students learn. Only progress data without your name or conversations is shared, as a file an adult gives to the study team.
Send anonymous counts that help us make the app faster. No questions, answers or names are sent.
When the app crashes, send a report about the crash. Your work is never in it.

Use the online study service for material you choose. Selected files or passages and your question are sent to our service to extract text and make cited notes, flashcards and quizzes. Service copies are deleted when processing ends, or after at most 15 minutes without activity. Your material stays on this device until you delete it. It is never used to train a model. This switch is separate from the online tutor; a parent or guardian must consent at checkout for anyone under 18.
